description_en: Modifies a specified data source based on the data source ID
description_zh: 根据数据源ID，修改指定的数据源
name: UpdateDataSource

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data source
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The category used to add the data source. Different types have different subtypes and corresponding parameter constraints. Examples:
InstanceMode: instance mode.
UrlMode: connection string mode
parameters.help_zh:
数据源添加的类别，不同type下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数约束，场景举例：
InstanceMode：实例模式。
UrlMode：连接串模式
parameters.name: connection_properties_mode

parameters.help_en: The description of the data source. The description can be up to 3,000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据源描述信息，长度不超过 3000 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The specific connection configuration of the data source, including the endpoint, access identity, and environment context. The EnvType property of the data source environment is a member attribute of this object. Valid values:
Dev: development environment.
Prod: production environment.

Different types of data sources have different attribute specifications in different configuration patterns (ConnectionPropertiesMode). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据源具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。数据源环境EnvType信息是此对象的成员属性，包括
Dev（开发环境）
Prod（生产环境）

不同类型的数据源在不同的配置模式（ConnectionPropertiesMode）下具有不同的属性信息规范，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.name: connection_properties

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the data source was updated. Valid values:
true: yes.
false: no
Success.description_zh:
数据源是否修改成功：

true：是

false：否
